rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=32, epochs=20, batch_size=1, lr=0.0005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-3 dual_domain_supervised on re-split Breast-CT (train3600/val200/test200, seed20260703), val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-1 hr=0.8095 (ep10,227s); iter-2 hr=0.8372 (ep20,440s). Doubling epochs gave +0.028 hr -> the c=16 fit was undertrained. 440s used, ~13 min budget still free. (2) Failure mode: unknown whether hr is now epochs-limited or CAPACITY-limited; since more training clearly helped and budget remains, the c=16 dual U-Net may be capacity-bound on the sino+image denoising. (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 16 -> 32 (both proj_dn and img_dn SmallUNet widths double; epochs=20/lr=5e-4/lambda_neg=1.0/grad_clip=1.0 all unchanged). (4) HYPOTHESIS: doubling channels to 32 raises val headroom above 0.8372 because iter-2 still had ample budget and a wider network can fit finer breast detail if the c=16 model was capacity-limited; expect hr ~0.85. Params ~0.47M -> ~1.85M. (5) BUDGET: wider net ~1.5-2x iter-2 step cost -> projected ~700-900s << 20 min (breast uses one shared PYRO-NN projector, FBP batched; 30-min sbatch wall). (6) Loop continues; iter-4 on landing. If wider net does NOT beat 0.8372, capacity is not the lever -> iter-4 pivots to lr.
